facts.claim: Isolation housing makes hippocampal atrophy, synapse and myelin associated protein loss, and glial neuroinflammatory reactions worse in aged APP695/PS1-dE9 transgenic mice.
facts.quote: Furthermore, exacerbated hippocampal atrophy, synapse and myelin associated protein loss, and glial neuroinflammatory reactions were observed in the hippocampus of isolated aged APP695/PS1-dE9 transgenic mice.

facts.claim: Isolation is linked to increased asymmetric atrophy of the hippocampus in an animal model of AD.
facts.quote: asymmetric atrophy of the hippocampus, recently described in human patients with dementia and modeled here for the first time in an animal model of AD, was found to increase with isolation.

facts.claim: Psychosocial stress causes apical dendritic atrophy of hippocampal CA3 pyramidal neurons in subordinate male tree shrews.
facts.quote: The stress-induced CA3 apical dendritic atrophy in subordinates was prevented by administering daily oral doses of the antiepileptic drug phenytoin (Dilantin, Sigma, St. Louis, MO) (200 mg/kg), which interferes with excitatory amino acid (EAA) action.

facts.claim: Social isolation in rodents is linked to increased corticosterone, altered motivation, increased stress responsiveness, and dysregulation of the mesocortical dopamine and limbic systems.
facts.quote: studies on the effects of social isolation in animals have observed similar physiological symptoms such as increased corticosterone, the rodent analog to human cortisol, and also display altered motivation, increased stress responsiveness, and dysregulation of the mesocortical dopamine and limbic systems.

facts.claim: Adults with age-related hearing loss show increased gray matter atrophy in the temporal lobe only, compared to adults with no-ARHL.
facts.quote: These data indicate that adults with ARHL show increased gray matter atrophy in the temporal lobe only (not in occipital, parietal, or frontal), compared to adults with no-ARHL.

research.angle: While social isolation and stress are linked to hippocampal atrophy and neuroinflammatory reactions in animal models, the evidence does not specifically confirm measurable atrophy in the prefrontal cortex in humans.
research.verdict: The evidence shows that isolation and stress can cause structural changes and atrophy in the hippocampus of animal models, but human data on specific brain regions like the prefrontal cortex is missing.
research.caveat: The findings regarding brain atrophy are primarily based on animal models of Alzheimer's disease and stress rather than direct human clinical measurements of social isolation.
